component_findings.artifact_integrity: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-4--go): Go's module system provides strong reproducibility via go.sum and the sum.golang.org checksum database for dependencies, and the go.dev/dl multi-version install method (`go get golang.org/dl/goX.Y.Z && goX.Y.Z download`) lets multiple toolchain versions coexist. However, a long-standing open issue shows the toolchain download page itself does not publish a simple machine-readable sha256sum file alongside each archive (checksums are embedded in page HTML), a minor gap versus a fully scriptable verification flow.
component_findings.channel_breadth: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-4--go): Docker Hub hosts an official golang image maintained by the docker-library/official-images program, covering many OS/arch/base-image flavors including Windows Server Core and Alpine variants.
component_findings.install_docs: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-4--go): Go distributes official binaries directly from go.dev/dl/ for all three major desktop platforms: a macOS .pkg installer, a Windows .msi installer, and Linux tarballs.
component_findings.installers: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-4--go): Go distributes official binaries directly from go.dev/dl/ for all three major desktop platforms: a macOS .pkg installer, a Windows .msi installer, and Linux tarballs.
component_findings.package_version_manager: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-4--go): Go is installable through Homebrew on macOS, and standard Linux package managers are documented as an alternative to the manual tarball route.

component_findings.governance_change: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-4--go): The Go team tests the development version of Go against all of Google's internal Go code on a rolling basis, and only installs a commit as Google's production toolchain once those tests pass; if a change breaks internal tests it is normally rolled back or rewritten before release.
